comparison.objective: Route a deformable rope in a prescribed figure-eight around two posts.
comparison.physical_skill: Topological deformable manipulation, ordered wrapping, crossing control, and release.
comparison.success_condition: At least four correctly ordered/directed cleat-line crossings, rope low and at rest, grippers clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Deformable topological routing is fundamentally different from rigid impact-tool manipulation and fracture debris containment.
